Hello jaskerin!

Welcome to the nicest town in all of England! This is your new home, Lewes, town of sugar, spice and everything nice!😊

I'm the town mentor (and a nice person, most of the time). I will try to help you as much as I can, so write to me or look for me in the taverns!

There have been some recent changes to the game, you can now play it from the web or even the mobile app. Although the game can be a slow burn, stick with it and you'll find a worthy community here in England to enjoy your experience with.

In order to progress in the game, you will need to acquire experience points (XP) for completing tasks. As you gain them, go to your "Skill Trees" menu, and use your Skill Points to open up new levels of activity. Each level unlocks new opportunities to work in the Mines, (Out of Town), work for another player (Town Hall, Job Offers tab), vote, and eventually cultivate your fields. Without unlocking certain skills, there are things you will not be able to do—working being the most important of these.
WARNING: be careful what you click, because once you have clicked to “learn” a skill, you cannot change it, so don’t use up all your skill points at the start. As you progress, there will be other skills you will need and you will get more points to use too.

These are the skills you should get first:

Under WORK, the SOCIABLE skill will allow you to see the job offers in the town hall and take a job there (if you meet the requirements).

Also under WORK, the MINER skill will allow you to work in a mine.
Depending on what mines you can see, you might also want to spend some skill points on increasing the production and wage for an individual type of mine (Stone, Iron, or Gold).
Still under WORK, the HARVESTER skill lets you work in your town’s resources (fish in the lake, with options to increase the production and amount collected).

Under POLITICS, the CITIZEN skill allows you to enlist in the town’s militia.

AGRICULTURE: Do not bother with this until you have acquired a field. But you might want to save some points for when you do, because otherwise you will not be able to hire workers, or ask for minimum statistics for workers. Currently, wheat is greatly valued so maybe consider it your first field!

CRAFTS: You only need this once you get a workshop.

According to the mayor's message, the most necessary skills for beginners are "Miner," "Stone Miner," "Harvester," "Sociable," "Agricultural Employer," "Demanding Employer," and "Citizen.". Those should allow you to perform the basic activities, and the rest is entirely up to you!
As a beginner, your best chance to gain points (and pounds) is to work the mines (Out of town-Work). TIP: Stone Mine, when opened, offers the best wage per hour!!! You are welcome!🤗

Keep in mind that once you use your points in the Skill Tree, you cannot take them back, so click wisely, choosing the most needed ones.

There is also a WIKI PAGE for RK with useful information, nicely structured. Just google Wiki renaissance kingdoms!

Your best chance to figure things out is to come to the taverns and talk away! We have a nice community here in Lewes and I'm sure older players will be happy to share their knowledge and expertise with you! And they will also benefit from your fresh vision of things! It is the only way to build a stronger, more fun community! And Lewes takes great pride in its community spirit! We aim to be more than an army of "clickers", so help us out, will you?😊

Whatever you do, do not forget to have fun and visit the forums for great role play (RP)!

See you around town!
In service,
Cerculetze
